text_en: Do you not know, brothers and sisters —for I am speaking to those who know the law—that the law is binding on a person only during that person’s lifetime?
text_cn: 弟兄们！我现在是对明白法律的人说话：难道你们不知道：法律统治人，只是在人活着的时候吗？

text_en: Thus a married woman is bound by the law to her husband as long as he lives; but if her husband dies, she is discharged from the law concerning the husband.
text_cn: 就如有丈夫的女人，当丈夫还活着的时候，是受法律束缚的；如果丈夫死了，她就不再因丈夫而受法律的束缚。

text_en: Accordingly, she will be called an adulteress if she lives with another man while her husband is alive. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law, and if she marries another man, she is not an adulteress.
text_cn: 所以，当丈夫活着的时候，她若依附别的男人，便称为淫妇；但如果丈夫死了，按法律她是自由的；她若依附别的男人，便不是淫妇。

text_en: In the same way, my friends, you have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to another, to him who has been raised from the dead in order that we may bear fruit for God.
text_cn: 所以，我的弟兄们！你们藉着基督的身体已死于法律了，为使你们属于另一位，就是属于由死者中复活的那一位，为叫我们给天主结果实，

text_en: While we were living in the flesh, our sinful passions, aroused by the law, were at work in our members to bear fruit for death.
text_cn: 因为我们还在肉性权下的时候，那藉法律而倾向于罪恶的情欲，在我们的肢体内活动，结出死亡的果实。

text_en: But now we are discharged from the law, dead to that which held us captive, so that we are slaves not under the old written code but in the new life of the Spirit.
text_cn: 但是现在，我们已死于束缚我们的势力，脱离了法律，如此，我们不应再拘泥于旧的条文，而应以新的心神事奉天主。

text_en: What then should we say? That the law is sin? By no means! Yet, if it had not been for the law, I would not have known sin. I would not have known what it is to covet if the law had not said, “You shall not covet. ”
text_cn: 那么，我们能说法律本身有罪吗？绝对不能！然而藉着法律，我才知道罪是什么。如果不是法律说：“不可贪恋！”我就不知道什么是贪情。

text_en: But sin, seizing an opportunity in the commandment, produced in me all kinds of covetousness. Apart from the law sin lies dead.
text_cn: 罪恶遂乘机藉着诫命，在我内发动各种贪情；原来若没有法律，罪恶便是死的。

text_en: I was once alive apart from the law, but when the commandment came, sin revived
text_cn: 从前我没有法律时，我是活人；但诫命一来，罪恶便活了起来，

text_en: and I died, and the very commandment that promised life proved to be death to me.
text_cn: 我反而死了。那本来应叫我生活的诫命，反叫我死了，

text_en: For sin, seizing an opportunity in the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.
text_cn: 因为罪恶藉着诫命乘机诱惑了我，也藉着诫命杀害了我。

text_en: So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy and just and good.
text_cn: 所以法律本是圣的，诫命也是圣的，是正义和美善的。

text_en: Did what is good, then, bring death to me? By no means! It was sin, working death in me through what is good, in order that sin might be shown to be sin, and through the commandment might become sinful beyond measure.
text_cn: 那么，是善事使我死了吗？绝对不是！而是罪恶。罪恶为显示罪恶的本性，藉着善事为我产生了死亡，以致罪恶藉着诫命成了极端的凶恶。

text_en: For we know that the law is spiritual; but I am of the flesh, sold into slavery under sin.
text_cn: 我们知道：法律是属神的，但我是属血肉的，已被卖给罪恶作奴隶。

text_en: I do not understand my own actions. For I do not do what I want, but I do the very thing I hate.
text_cn: 因为我不明白我作的是什么：我所愿意的，我偏不作；我所憎恨的，我反而去作。

text_en: Now if I do what I do not want, I agree that the law is good.
text_cn: 我若去作我所不愿意的，这便是承认法律是善的。

text_en: But in fact it is no longer I that do it, but sin that dwells within me.
text_cn: 实际上作那事的已不是我，而是在我内的罪恶。

text_en: For I know that nothing good dwells within me, that is, in my flesh. I can will what is right, but I cannot do it.
text_cn: 我也知道，善不在我内，即不在我的肉性内，因为我有心行善，但实际上却不能行善。

text_en: For I do not do the good I want, but the evil I do not want is what I do.
text_cn: 因此，我所愿意的善，我不去行；而我所不愿意的恶，我却去作。

text_en: Now if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I that do it, but sin that dwells within me.
text_cn: 但我所不愿意的，我若去作，那么已不是我作那事，而是在我内的罪恶。

text_en: So I find it to be a law that when I want to do what is good, evil lies close at hand.
text_cn: 所以我发现这条规律：就是我愿意为善的时候，总有邪恶依附着我。

text_en: For I delight in the law of God in my inmost self,
text_cn: 因为照我的内心，我是喜悦天主的法律；

text_en: but I see in my members another law at war with the law of my mind, making me captive to the law of sin that dwells in my members.
text_cn: 可是，我发觉在我的肢体内，另有一条法律，与我理智所赞同的法律交战，并把我掳去，叫我隶属于那在我肢体内的罪恶的法律。

text_en: Wretched man that I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?
text_cn: 我这个人真不幸呀！谁能救我脱离这该死的肉身呢？

text_en: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I am a slave to the law of God, but with my flesh I am a slave to the law of sin.
text_cn: 感谢天主，藉着我们的主耶稣基督。这样看来，我这人是以理智去服从天主的法律，而以肉性去服从罪恶的法律。
